assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO small original medieval mountain-maintenance spaces, pixel-art REVIEW board. Reference only wind-worn cold grey stone, brown timber, sparse snow/moss, modest warm lanterns; do not copy entire monastery. COARSE chunky readable pixel clusters. Top-down oblique orthographic, horizontal back walls vertical posts, square-axis paving, no diamond isometric. LEFT ground-level RETURN SHELTER near old bell station, not inside workshop: visible detached broken bell clapper on low bench, blank wooden STOP board facing fenced dangerous side platform whose cracked beam remains clearly closed, and simple forked return-route marker directing to broad intact foreground path. Only partial bell-tower support in upper background, no new full bell workshop. Safe return path entirely on stable ground, never underneath hanging equipment or over cracked platform. RIGHT independent maintenance rest hut: warm small lantern, bench, cup, one completed-shift wooden wage token in tray and separate EMPTY unsigned renewal plaque hanging aside. Exactly TWO OPEN doorways at front-left/front-right connect dry exterior path, no bell-ringing gate. No persons; no assumption everyone returned, accepted pay or renewed permanent work. No magic/crystals, political banner, throne, modern symbols, labels, writing, numbers or watermark. Distinguish stopping unsafe scenic convenience from preserving ordinary safe return.
assets.qa: v1 camera drifted into diagonal cliff diorama with elevated scenic return and ambiguous dual door; preserved only. v2 targets flatter ground plane and horizontal square paving, keeps broken clapper/closed dangerous side recess, and adds two front openings to rest shelter; preferred. Still high-resolution pixel-style texture, ground width/height/collision unverified. Gold circular wage tally is symbolic, not runtime amount.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create TWO new small medieval mountain quest spaces, review pixel art. Match reference's ORTHOGRAPHIC square paving and horizontal back wall/vertical posts, muted cold grey stone and brown timber, coarse hard-edged pixel clusters. Do NOT reuse reference bell machinery/workshop; no panoramic cliffs. LEFT narrow ground-level safe exterior measurement corridor along OUTSIDE wall of closed dangerous echo chamber: three short fixed shallow stone locating grooves in floor, physical placement markers in grooves, closed original reading folio on small side shelf. Chamber door closed and not needed for safe through-passage; wide corridor extends left and right to ordinary dry exterior path. No audio magic, ghost, mouths, luminous runes. RIGHT simple dry calibration room under plain window light, bench holds a wood-and-iron ruler with EXACTLY THREE adjacent measurement slots, first TWO occupied by small sliding blocks, THIRD visibly EMPTY and NOT patched over; independent fixed squared stone comparison object next to ruler. NO giant brass/steam gauges or replacement miraculous apparatus, no bodies connected. Keep ruler enlarged just enough to read missing third slot; maintain simple mechanical ordinary medieval tools. Open front exit direct to dry path, no mandatory echo-room crossing. No workers, signatures or all-stable certification. No text, numbers, labels, watermark. This is ground-groove and missing-measure review, complementary to existing three-instrument N15 station, not duplicate machinery.
assets.qa: Three fixed locating grooves visible outside closed chamber; separate comparison bench shows three slots with third empty and an independent block. Safe open front access remains, but corridor side through-exits not fully shown; not route/collision proof. Props enlarged for reading, no miraculous apparatus or full-stability claim.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Review pixel art, TWO small original medieval mountain maintenance spaces side by side. Reference only orthographic horizontal back walls/vertical posts, square-grid floor, grey stone brown timber muted linen, coarse square pixel clusters. DO NOT copy bell equipment, machinery or entire workshop. LEFT modest authority meeting hut: simple LOW table with three widely SEPARATE plain seats, tabletop has exactly THREE IRON KEYS with clearly different bows (round, triangle, square), each in its OWN small tray. These symbolize research, operation and custody separately; no master key, throne, magical pedestal, crown or central glowing crystal. CLOSED plain case along side wall, not on chair. OPEN exit faces ordinary inn road. RIGHT independent wage pavilion on that EXTERIOR road, fully accessible WITHOUT entering meeting hut: small finite wage-token tray, separate inspection-expense pouch, and BLANK renewal-expiry tag, each distinct. One public-facing counter and simple stool, no unsigned form blocking exit, no people or signatures. Safe dry street across foreground links BOTH open fronts. No scene of completed payment, universal permanent labor or authority granted. No numbers, text, labels, red crosses, readable ledger, heraldry or watermark. Adds specific separated keys and independent wage station to existing neutral discussion table concept; do not recreate old N16 proposal room.
assets.qa: Three separate keys with circle/triangle/square bows, three seats, closed side case and independent public wage room rendered. Finite pay tray, separate inspection pouch and blank future tag clear. This supplements 70 proposal table rather than replacing it; empty seats do not grant authority or imply consent.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO ORIGINAL medieval mountain outer-maintenance spaces, pixel-art REVIEW, no underground carrier pit. Use reference only for camera, horizontal stone walls, vertical posts, square paving and muted grey brown palette, coarse crisp pixel clusters. LEFT patrol pavilion on SAFE side of outer seal road: CLOSED low side gate bearing intact wax-and-cord seal across latch, blank stop board clearly blocking optional disused shortcut, small shelf with one limited-shift patrol tally, warm lantern. Broad ordinary return path passes IN FRONT of closed shortcut and remains open to left/right, cannot require breaking seal. No magic portal, crystal throne or total monastery lockout. RIGHT departing worker's key-return room: exactly two OPEN doorways separated by short wall, both face ordinary dry inn road. Low counter shows a small returned iron KEY in shallow tray, unused BLANK future-shift tag separate, and completed-wage tally separate; closed limited-records folio on shelf, no master access roster. Ordinary travel cloak and small bag on stool but NO person, no signature, no compulsory renewed duty. Safe wide foreground square-grid paving links two exits to street. No broken seal, aftermath explosion, repeated reward, new ending, text, labels, numbers, watermark. Makes handing over finite duty and leaving possible, cannot prove anyone already paid or departed.
assets.qa: Intact sealed side gate/stop board, open foreground bypass and two independent rear doors in departure room rendered. Returned key, future tag and wage tray distinct. Added blue pennant with abstract pale chevron is unrequested decoration, not canonical faction insignia; remove in production. Cloak/bags are staging, not proof of departed workers.
